in_sanskrit.name: दीपेन्द्र
in_sanskrit.meaning: God of light, illumination, and knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Deep (दीप) means deep, light, or knowledge. Andra (अन्द्र) is a suffix meaning male. So, Deependra means 'God of deep knowledge and illumination' or 'God of deep understanding'.

in_hindi.name: दीपेन्द्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: Deep (दीप) means deep, light, or knowledge. Andra (अन्द्र) is a suffix meaning male. So, Deependra means 'God of deep knowledge and illumination' or 'God of deep understanding' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: தீபேந்திர
in_tamil.long_meaning: Deepam (தீபம்) means deep, light, or knowledge. Endiram (எந்திரம்) is a suffix meaning male. So, Thipendiram means 'God of deep knowledge and illumination' or 'God of deep understanding' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: దీపేద్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: Deepamu (దీపము) means deep, light, or knowledge. Eduramu (ఎద్రము) is a suffix meaning male. So, Dipeeduramu means 'God of deep knowledge and illumination' or 'God of deep understanding' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Deependra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deependra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deep One, A name of Lord Vishnu, represents deep knowledge, courage, and strength.

in_bengali.name: Deependra
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Deep One
in_bengali.long_meaning: Deependra একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Deep One, A name of Lord Vishnu, represents deep knowledge, courage, and strength.
